profile.company: NICE CROWD (The American Black Film Festival)
profile.belief: Ah, so many things… but, ultimately I am the cliche of wanting to work in entertainment because cinema just means so much to me. They were my escape during tough times in my childhood and filled my head with stories and characters that allowed me to build community at various different times. I want to work in/around the things that made me so happy and hopefully contribute to a project that makes someone feel the same way.
profile.working_on: I would love to write and direct a film/show and I’m also interested in interview show-hosting as well.
